title.zh-Hant: Echo Dot（第 5 代，2022）— 木炭色

blurb.en: A compact Alexa speaker for music, timers, and routines with compatible smart-home devices. This is the 2022 fifth-generation model in Charcoal.
blurb.zh-Hant: 小巧的 Alexa 喇叭，用來播放音樂、設定計時，也可以對相容的智慧家居裝置執行例行程序。這是 2022 年第 5 代，顏色為木炭色。

title.zh-Hant: Echo Show 5（第 3 代）— 木炭色

blurb.en: A 5.5-inch smart display for weather, video, photos, and voice control of compatible devices. This is the third-generation Charcoal model, with a camera and a physical shutter.
blurb.zh-Hant: 5.5 吋智慧螢幕，可查看天氣、播放影片與照片，並用聲音控制相容裝置。這是第 3 代木炭色，鏡頭附有實體遮蓋。

blurb.en: The 2024 Kindle Paperwhite in black, with 16 GB of storage, a 7-inch glare-free screen, USB-C charging, and a waterproof design. This listing usually includes lock-screen ads — confirm the exact configuration on Amazon.
blurb.zh-Hant: 2024 年 Kindle Paperwhite 黑色款，16 GB 儲存、7 吋防眩光螢幕、USB-C 充電，機身可防水。這個商品頁通常含鎖定畫面廣告，請在 Amazon 核對實際規格。

blurb.en: A streaming stick for 4K video, with Wi-Fi 6 and an Alexa Voice Remote. Apps and what is in the box depend on the listing — confirm both on Amazon.
blurb.zh-Hant: 可看 4K 影片的串流棒，支援 Wi-Fi 6，並附 Alexa 語音遙控器。可用的應用程式與盒內物品以 Amazon 商品頁為準。

blurb.en: The 6-quart Instant Pot Duo combines pressure cooking, slow cooking, rice, steam, sauté, yogurt, and keep-warm. The inner pot is stainless steel.
blurb.zh-Hant: 6 夸脫 Instant Pot Duo，結合壓力鍋、慢燉、煮飯、蒸、煎炒、優格與保溫。內鍋為不鏽鋼。

title.zh-Hant: Ninja AF101 氣炸鍋，4 夸脫

blurb.en: A 4-quart Ninja air fryer with air fry, roast, reheat, and dehydrate modes. The basket is sized for about one or two people.
blurb.zh-Hant: Ninja 4 夸脫氣炸鍋，具氣炸、烘烤、再加熱與乾燥模式。容量大約適合一到兩人。

blurb.en: An ergonomic wireless mouse in Graphite, with quiet clicks, a high-resolution sensor, and USB-C charging. This is the standard-edition listing.
blurb.zh-Hant: 石墨色人體工學無線滑鼠，按鍵較安靜，感測器解析度高，並以 USB-C 充電。這是一般版的商品頁。

blurb.en: A 30W USB-C GaN wall charger with a foldable plug, in black. A charging cable is not included.
blurb.zh-Hant: 黑色 30W USB-C 氮化鎵牆充，插頭可折疊。包裝不含充電線。

blurb.en: Over-ear wireless noise-cancelling headphones in black. Sony lists about 30 hours of battery life with noise cancelling on.
blurb.zh-Hant: 黑色耳罩式無線降噪耳機。Sony 標示在開啟降噪時，電池大約可使用 30 小時。

blurb.en: Four second-generation AirTags for keys, bags, and other items you misplace. Setup uses the Find My app on a compatible iPhone or iPad.
blurb.zh-Hant: 第二代 AirTag 四入組，可掛在鑰匙或行李上，用 iPhone 或 iPad 的「尋找」App 定位。需要相容的 Apple 裝置。
